FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 165 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of public institutions
of higher education, as well as the Executive Budget Office, to report the amount of state and
federal funds received and expended by the institution and to develop an operations plan based
on certain reductions in funding.
